ac-gdy-config-writingstyle-wskazuje-styl: deferred, not not-automatable: the spec (M01/M15) says an unresolvable config.writingStyle hard-fails at SERVER START, while the host validates lazily per project context and deliberately soft-fails (project-context.ts) so one broken value cannot 500 every /api/projects/:id route including the Settings screen needed to fix it. The spec never resolved where that validation runs in a multi-project host, so the message split this AC asks for was held back with it — see the clarification patch filed against brief 0-2-56-to-0-2-57. Remove this entry once the spec answers.
ac-gdy-typ-ac-nie-jest-aktywny-w-projekc: deferred, not not-automatable: the spec contradicts itself here. This AC (and brief 0-2-57-to-0-2-58 step 5) asks the host to skip a subagent contribution when the plugin's entity type is inactive, while M13 `m13plset` states as a GENERAL rule that contributes.settings/commands/subagents are active on pool+trust alone, independent of the `config.entities` whitelist, with no per-subagent opt-out. The code implements the M13 rule (project-host.ts listSubagents, types.ts). No gate was added — see the `incorrect` patch filed against brief 0-2-57-to-0-2-58. Remove this entry once the spec picks one of the two.
